en.archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Cyberpunk 2077 launches its free Edgerunners 2 update; Katana ZERO DLC grows to sequel size

entries.headline: Cyberpunk 2077 launches a free Edgerunners 2 update with a prequel quest and dual wielding
entries.summary: CD PROJEKT RED has released the free Edgerunners 2 Update. Its new quest sends V to help Weak Kingsley at Night City Prison and serves as a prequel to the anime’s second season; the update also adds Weak’s gear, the HKGN 102.FM station, dual wielding, and more customization.
entries.verification: Xbox Wire 已打开的一手稿明确确认免费更新现已推出，并列出新任务、夜之城监狱、Weak Kingsley、HKGN 102.FM 与双持武器等内容。

entries.headline: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE arrives on Xbox as an HD-2D reworking of Brave Exvius
entries.summary: Square Enix and LANCARSE rebuilt the story of FINAL FANTASY BRAVE EXVIUS as a single-player, single-purchase RPG with HD-2D presentation. Xbox Wire confirms it is available now on Xbox.
entries.verification: Xbox Wire 一手稿确认作品现已登陆 Xbox，并明确其 HD-2D 表现、原作改编关系与单机一次性购买定位。

entries.headline: Katana ZERO DLC grows to “full sequel” size with more than 30 new tracks
entries.summary: Developer Askiisoft says the DLC remains in production, has grown to the size of a full sequel, and will include a soundtrack with more than 30 new songs. No release date was announced.
entries.verification: Gematsu 与电ファミニコゲーマー均打开并独立转述 Askiisoft 同一公开更新，规模与30余首新曲两项核心事实一致。

entries.headline: Super Danganronpa 2×2 lowers its PC system requirements
entries.summary: Spike Chunsoft has revised the PC requirements after criticism that the original targets were unusually high. The remake is due January 14, 2027 for Steam, Epic, Switch 2, Switch, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON 已打开并明确引用 Spike Chunsoft 当日公告，核实 PC 配置更新与既定发售平台、日期。

entries.headline: Game Boy Nintendo Classics adds three more games
entries.summary: Nintendo has added Moguranya, Pinball: 66 Crocodiles on the Move, and Phantasm to Game Boy Nintendo Classics for Nintendo Switch Online members on Switch and Switch 2.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON 已打开并明确转述任天堂当日上线信息，三款作品与适用平台均有列明。

entries.headline: Phantom Blade Zero gets a launch trailer; PS5 physical editions follow in 2027
entries.summary: S-GAME released the launch trailer and confirmed Standard, Deluxe, and Ultimate physical editions for PlayStation 5 in 2027. The game uses Unreal Engine 5 and features more than 30 weapons and over 20 Phantom Edges.
entries.verification: Gematsu 已打开并明确转述 S-GAME 公告，核实上市预告与2027年三档 PS5 实体版计划。

entries.headline: Co-op comedy horror game QUIET launches a demo on Steam and Epic
entries.summary: LINE Games has released a PC demo through Steam and the Epic Games Store. Players control duck-like aliens trying to escape their landlady after crash-landing on Earth.
entries.verification: 4Gamer 已打开并明确转述 LINE Games 当日发布信息，试玩平台与核心玩法身份一致。

entries.headline: Wall World Strategy launches November 11 with colony-management gameplay
entries.summary: Alawar set a November 11 release date for the Wall World spin-off, which shifts the series toward colony management while retaining its signature multi-legged mech.
entries.verification: 4Gamer 已打开并明确转述发行商 Alawar 的日期公告与游戏定位。

entries.headline: League of Legends allows up to 10 replay downloads per hour
entries.summary: Riot Games revised its disputed replay policy in Patch 26.21: players can still download other players’ match replays, with a limit of ten per hour. The patch also includes champion balance changes and True Damage-themed content.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON 已打开并明确转述 Riot Games 的26.21版本变更，下载额度与版本号清楚。

entries.headline: ANOMALITH composer Yuka Kitamura explains the sound of an everyday world turning strange
entries.summary: In an original interview, lead composer Yuka Kitamura describes using familiar, everyday timbres to express the game’s blend of Showa-era retro aesthetics, liminal spaces, and anomalies. The game is due October 29 for PS5, Switch 2, and Steam.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON 原创邮件访谈已打开，受访者身份、创作思路与作品平台日期均在正文中明确。

entries.headline: ACE COMBAT ZERO becomes a standalone Steam app for preorder owners
entries.summary: Bandai Namco now lets ACE COMBAT 8 preorder customers download and launch ACE COMBAT ZERO as a separate 3.2GB app, removing the need to install the 140GB main game. It can still be launched from ACE COMBAT 8.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON 已打开并核实官方调整后的独立商店页与发行说明，单体容量及适用对象清楚。

sourceReport.note: English copy mirrors the complete selected fact frames. Calendar coverage remains explicitly partial where platform sources or product pages were limited.
